# RankCrest

Illustrated rank crest with rank name and roman tier.

```jsx
<RankCrest character="hunter" />
<RankCrest character="hunter" rank="EMERALD HUNTER" tier="III" layout="column" />
```

- Crests are supplied raster art per character (`assets/crests/crest-*.png`) — never redraw them.
- Rank names are uppercase, letterspaced .06em, in the character accent.
